misfits.what: Per-rider average mark per section (Gjennomsnitt) printed; no protocol field.
misfits.suggestion: Add total.average (derived, optional) or declare averages derivable and not stored.

misfits.what: classification.counts is typed for mark counts but the header prints entrant counts (Registrert/Startet/Fullførte ikke/Ferdig/Poengsum). Keys entered/started/retired/finished/scored are a local convention.
misfits.suggestion: Add classification.entrant_counts {entered, started, retired, finished, scored} with fixed keys, separate from mark counts.

misfits.what: The 16th/17th split on equal 27 is not explained on the sheet; tie_break has no way to say the rule is inferred by the mapper.
Straff (1 mark for several riders) has no stated reason; penalty code vocabulary is open so 'other' carries it.
misfits.suggestion: Publish a penalty code list (late-finish, missed-section, yellow-card, outside-assistance, other) so codes are comparable.

misfits.what: Section sets differ by class (men S3-S5, women S2-S4) inside one qualifying part; part.sections can only list the union, the per-class set lives on section.classes and grid.sections.
misfits.suggestion: Allow part.sections_by_class or class.sections so a part can state which sections each class rides.

mapping.unread: Nothing unread. The 6 sampled riders were mapped by hand; the other 18 were added later by parsing the PDF text layer. Every rider's marks agree with the printed lap sums, mark counts and Poeng, and the parser's output matched the hand-mapped riders.
